name: context-manager-skill
description: Saves a handoff before context compaction, holds compaction until it exists, compacts at your threshold, restores the handoff afterwards and shows a live context meter. Per-project or global settings. Windows, macOS and Linux.

prep_at.title: Prepare handoff at (tokens)
prep_at.description: Context size at which Claude writes a compaction handoff. A project's .claude/context-manager.json overrides this.

compact_at.title: Compact at (tokens)
compact_at.description: Compaction runs once context reaches this size and the handoff is saved; it is held below it.

force_at.title: Safety limit (tokens)
force_at.description: Above this size compaction always runs, handoff or not.

auto_compact.title: Compact automatically
auto_compact.description: Compact on its own after the turn where context reaches the compaction threshold with a saved handoff. Off: you type /compact.

show_meter.title: Show context meter
show_meter.description: Show context size and handoff state above the prompt (terminal and desktop app).
